name: telegram-relay
description: Answer Claude Code questions, permission prompts and follow-ups from Telegram while you're away from the keyboard

idle_seconds.title: Away after (seconds)
idle_seconds.description: In auto mode, prompts go to Telegram after this many seconds without keyboard or mouse input.

when_unknown.title: If idle time can't be detected
when_unknown.description: What auto mode does when it can't read idle time, e.g. over Remote-SSH: desk keeps prompts in Claude Code, away sends them to Telegram.

idle_command.title: Custom idle command
idle_command.description: Optional shell command that prints idle time in milliseconds. Leave empty to use the built-in detection (GNOME, xprintidle, screen lock).

answer_timeout.title: Answer timeout (seconds)
answer_timeout.description: How long a question or permission prompt waits for a Telegram answer before it goes back to Claude Code.

stop_wait.title: Reply window after Claude finishes (seconds)
stop_wait.description: How long to wait for a Telegram reply that continues the session. 0 sends the message without waiting.

relay_questions.title: Relay questions
relay_questions.description: Send Claude's multiple-choice questions to Telegram.

relay_permissions.title: Relay permission prompts
relay_permissions.description: Send permission prompts to Telegram with Allow / Deny buttons.

relay_finished.title: Relay finished turns
relay_finished.description: Send a message when Claude finishes, so you can reply to continue.

relay_notifications.title: Relay other notifications
relay_notifications.description: Forward other Claude Code notifications as plain alerts.
